fields.name: View
fields.evidence: Vertex slots 0-2 of program 6183 are dotted with the instance position and the vertex to reach view space; the same slots as the WildRenderingSharp GsysContext view matrix.

fields.name: ViewProjection
fields.evidence: Slots 3-6, as WildRenderingSharp GsysContext.ViewProjection; not read by program 6183.

fields.name: Projection
fields.evidence: Vertex slots 7-10 of program 6183 produce gl_Position from the view-space position.

fields.name: InverseView
fields.evidence: Slots 11-13, as WildRenderingSharp GsysContext.InverseView; read by the fragment stage of program 6183.

fields.name: NearFar
fields.evidence: Slot 14: near, far, near/far, 1 - near/far (WildRenderingSharp GsysContext.NearFar).

fields.name: ProjectionA
fields.evidence: Fragment slots 35-37 of program 6183: three rows applied to the view-space position, the first two divided by the third, giving a screen coordinate. Filled with the projection's x, y and w rows (the previous-frame or second-camera role is not known).

fields.name: ProjectionB
fields.evidence: Fragment slots 38-40 of program 6183: a second projective triple like ProjectionA (x row 38, y row 39, w row 40).

fields.name: ScreenFade
fields.evidence: Slot 41 .xy, programs 6183, 20052, 17163: multiply two clamped screen-edge terms, so (1, 1) leaves them whole.

fields.name: ShadowScale
fields.evidence: Fragment slot 64 of program 6183: .x and .y scale terms in the shadow/ambient branch. Neutral value (1, 1) is a guess.

fields.name: ShadowCascade0
fields.evidence: Fragment slots 0x304-0x30F of program 1843 (a model program that reads gsys_depth_shadow_cascade): each cascade is four slots, the x, y, depth and w rows of a view-space-to-shadow-texture matrix (x/w and y/w index the layer, depth/w is the compare reference), applied to the view-space position the slots 0-2 produce. Cascade 0 is slots 0x304-0x307.

fields.name: ShadowCascade1
fields.evidence: Fragment slots 0x304-0x30F of program 1843 (a model program that reads gsys_depth_shadow_cascade): each cascade is four slots, the x, y, depth and w rows of a view-space-to-shadow-texture matrix (x/w and y/w index the layer, depth/w is the compare reference), applied to the view-space position the slots 0-2 produce. Cascade 1 is slots 0x308-0x30B.

fields.name: ShadowCascade2
fields.evidence: Fragment slots 0x304-0x30F of program 1843 (a model program that reads gsys_depth_shadow_cascade): each cascade is four slots, the x, y, depth and w rows of a view-space-to-shadow-texture matrix (x/w and y/w index the layer, depth/w is the compare reference), applied to the view-space position the slots 0-2 produce. Cascade 2 is slots 0x30C-0x30F.

fields.name: ShadowSplits
fields.evidence: Slot 0x315 x, y, z of program 1843: the negated view-space depth above which the fragment moves to cascade 1, 2 and 3 (compared in that order, the layer is capped at 2).
